sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Importation of Deep-Frozen Meat Carcasses and Pelagic Fish

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012, Chapter 10 Investment)
Colombia–Canada Free Trade Agreement (in force 2011, Chapter 8 Investment)
Trade Agreement between Colombia, Peru and the European Union (in force 2013)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF creation), Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT measures), Estatuto Tributario Art. 86-5 (added by Ley 2010 de 2019), Decreto 2013 de 2021 (UBO registration), DIAN Resolución 164 de 2022, Circular Externa 023 de 2022 (Superintendencia de Sociedades), Decreto 1074 de 2015 (commercial registry powers).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of corporate shareholder (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial registry/company registry in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the issuing state is a party) or Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized special power of attorney (Poder Especial) granted to the Colombian legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof of address of each UBO and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuance authority and public notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter in respect of the subscribed capital remittance, issued by the remitting bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (only required when foreign bank evidence is relied on)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, legal representatives and commercial counterparts against the DIAN UBO register, UIAF Presidential Action lists (Listas Vinculadas a la Financiación del Terrorismo), the Superintendencia de Sociedades's circular-issued PEP lists, OFAC/UN/EU consolidated sanctions and high-risk country indices. The compliance unit must maintain a synchronous AML/KYC file with risk rating below 5% total exposure to covered persons and must perform continuous transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – https://www.rues.org.co (operated through Cámaras de Comercio)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must use the Spanish alphabet and Latin script, with accents permitted; the name must be in Spanish or universally recognized trade terms, and must not contain non-Spanish script. A Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada must finish with the abbreviation 'S.A.S.'. The full corporate name must be unique and not unduly similar to an existing registered name in any Cámara de Comercio jurisdiction.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Colombia when implying official state sponsorship
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection by the Cámara de Comercio, the applicant must submit a revised name application or file a reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) before the same Cámara within ten (10) business days, and a subsidiary appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within five (5) business days, under Ley 1437 de 2011. The appeal must set out the grounds of unfair distinction and include evidence of prior use in commerce.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are accepted for registration and statutory domicile; however, the wholesale importation of deep-frozen meat and pelagic fish requires a physical warehouse and cold-chain facility with prior sanitary and environmental permits issued by INVIMA and the relevant municipal environmental authority. Consequently, a fully virtual office is not sufficient as the operational headquarters, but it may be used for the registered-office obligation during the pre-operational window.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 70% probability within the first 12 months of operations because INVIMA and DIAN perform unannounced cold-chain, price, and inventory inspections for imported food commodities.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio del circuito competente (e.g., Bogotá)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the S.A.S. private incorporation document and signatures
Commercial registration (matrícula mercantil) and filing of articles of incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on declared capital (UVT system)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of existence and legal representation (certificado de existencia y representación legal)
Apostille or consular legalization of foreign UBO and shareholder documents (per document)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Colombia or issuing country)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedule or statutory apostille charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registration and DIAN electronic filing assistance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No governmental fee; service included in counsel fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Local counsel legal due diligence and incorporation coordination (flat fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for standard S.A.S. incorporation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1, 3, 9, 17 and 45; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971); Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Book 2, commercial registration provisions; customs and trade registration per Decreto 1165 de 2019.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the corporate domicile, acting through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) portal, under the control of the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución with annexed bylaws (estatutos), followed by the issuance of the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal by the Chamber of Commerce.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an S.A.S.; the bylaws may declare nominal capital and the paid-in portion may be contributed within a maximum term of two years (Law 1258/2008, Article 9). No escrow account is required by company law; in-kind contributions require appraisal, and banks will expect the paid-in equity to cover the initial frozen-product purchase orders.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that: (1) the initial subscribed share capital and the payment installment terms are acknowledged as stated in the incorporation document; (2) the company's registered office is fixed at [city, department, address]; (3) [name] is appointed legal representative, with broad powers for contracts, banking, and imports; (4) the legal representative is authorized to register the RUT before DIAN, to request the INVIMA sanitary import authorizations and ICA certificates, to obtain environmental and fire-safety clearances, and to open bank accounts and revolving letter-of-credit facilities; (5) all acts already performed to prepare the wholesale deep-frozen beef, carcass, and pelagic seafood import operations are ratified and approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Search and Reservation (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office domicile via the RUES online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name-search request on the RUES platform or at the Chamber window specifying the exact proposed company name. Obtain the homonymy certificate confirming the name is not identical, equal, or confusingly similar to an existing enterprise, and reserve the name for 30 business days.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name (up to three variants)
Identity documents of founding shareholders (cédula or passport)
Homonimia search application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, immediately file an alternative-name request with corrected variants or appeal the decision to the registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Private Incorporation Document and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (if real property is contributed) or founding shareholders executing the private document
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the incorporation instrument under Law 1258 of 2008 covering corporate name, domicile, corporate purpose (wholesale importation of frozen meat and seafood, ISIC 4632), authorized and subscribed capital, payment term not exceeding two years, administrator appointment rules, fiscal year, and winding-up rules. Execute with electronic or handwritten signatures; protocolize before a notary if real estate is contributed in kind.
required_dossiers: Draft bylaws (estatutos) with the mandatory clauses of Law 1258/2008
Identity documents of all founding shareholders and the appointed administrator
Appraisal reports (avaluos) and tax receipts for in-kind contributions
Power of attorney where a representative signs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any omissions flagged by the registry and re-execute the document; substantive defects may be cured by a subsequent unanimous shareholders' resolution ratified in writing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant Registration and Issuance of Corporate Existence Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Registro Mercantil) through the online 'Registro en Línea' service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the signed incorporation document into the Chamber's online system, pay the applicable registration duties, and await approval. Upon approval the Chamber assigns the registration number, issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, registers the corporate books (minutes book, shareholders register, contribution register), and requests the initial NIT assignment from DIAN.
required_dossiers: Executed private incorporation document
Certificado de homonimia (name availability certificate)
RUES registration form with ISIC 4632 economic activity classification
Proof of payment of registry duties
Administrator acceptance statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for defects, cure the file within the registry's notice period and resubmit; late registration may be done as 'registro extemporáneo' with the applicable surcharge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: DIAN Tax Registration, RUT, Electronic Invoicing and Importer Status
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - 'Impuestos y Trámites' virtual portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the RUT registration with the SAS NIT, incorporate the economic activities equivalent to ISIC 4632 and NAICS 424420, obtain the electronic invoicing authorization and the legal representative's digital signature, and confirm the importer status required for customs declarations under the current customs regime.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT pre-registration data and NIT application
Legal representative identity document and electronic signature certificate
Proof of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN queries the registration, correct the data through the RUT correction procedure or file clarifications through the DIAN PQR channel and resubmit the application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Onboarding, Trade Finance Lines and VUCE Access
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Supervised financial entities and the Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the corporate bank account by presenting the certified corporate certificate and board resolution, execute the SWIFT/TT master agreement and the revolving letter-of-credit facility, complete the beneficial-ownership and SARLAFT questionnaire, and register the company in VUCE to process sanitary and import authorizations electronically for each refrigerated shipment.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Board resolution appointing the legal representative and authorized signatories
RUT and tax compliance verifications
Beneficial ownership and PEP declarations
Commercial references and projected cash flow for the LC facility
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SARLAFT/KYC review flags the applicant, provide source-of-funds evidence and sworn statements, then re-apply; escalation to the bank's compliance committee is available within 20 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Operational Sanitary, Environmental and Fire-Safety Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INVIMA; ICA for animal-origin imports at ports; Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR); Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos; Secretaría Distrital de Salud
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File with INVIMA the sanitary authorization for the cold-storage establishment and the per-shipment import authorizations for frozen beef carcasses and pelagic fish supported by exporting-country health certificates. Simultaneously obtain the low-impact environmental registration for the warehouse (wastewater, solid waste, refrigerant management) and the fire-safety certificate for the cold chambers; present ICA documentation for animal-origin controls at the port of entry.
required_dossiers: INVIMA sanitary registration application for food establishments
Cold-chain and HACCP protocol for the storage facility
Health certificates from exporting countries for each origin destination
Environmental registration and wastewater discharge forms
Structural and electrical installation certificates for cold rooms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If INVIMA or the environmental authority issues observations, cure the file within the granted period (up to 30 calendar days); a precautionary suspension may be lifted by demonstrating conformity, and administrative appeals may be filed within 10 business days of a refusal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA), with co-competence of the Instituto Colombiano Agropecuario (ICA) for animal-origin market access control
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización Sanitaria de Importación (INVIMA per-shipment authorization processed through VUCE) and Concepto Sanitario Favorable del Establecimiento de Almacenamiento (cold-storage warehouse)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low-impact category: no full environmental impact assessment is required for a refrigerated commercial warehouse; an environmental registration with wastewater, solid waste, and refrigerant management permits suffices, unless the project evolves into slaughtering or ammonia-based industrial refrigeration triggering the thresholds of Decreto 1076 de 2015, in which case a full environmental impact study may be demanded.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Non-domestic wastewater discharged to the public sewer must meet Resolución 0631 de 2015 standards (pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 no greater than 200 mg/L, TSS no greater than 100 mg/L, fats and oils no greater than 20 mg/L); stationary refrigeration and power-generation sources must comply with the air emission limits of Resolución 909 de 2008 for PM, CO, and VOCs; refrigerant and ozone-depleting substance management follows Ley 2232 de 2022 phase-down rules; hazardous and meat waste must be handled and manifested under Resolución 062 de 2007.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain the Certificado de Seguridad Humana y Contra Incendios from the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos covering the cold chambers, including refrigerant-gas detection, fire suppression, and unobstructed egress; present a structural engineer's load certificate for the insulated facility; implement and document the SG-SST workplace safety program under Decreto 1072 de 2015 and Resolución 0312 de 2019 with high-risk occupational insurance (ARL Class IV/V); and pass the municipal health inspection for food storage premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — https://www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-incorporated investors establishing a Colombian SAS must (1) appoint a legal representative domiciled in Colombia; (2) file the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) application with DIAN through authorized channels to obtain the Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT); (3) activate the electronic signature (firma electrónica) acquisition procedure for DIAN portal services; and (4) formally register as a VAT responsible entity (responsable de IVA) before the first customs import declaration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (SAS is a Colombian resident entity subject to corporate income tax at 35% for fiscal year 2024); Territorial_Scope: Worldwide residence taxation; Tax_Exempt_Zone: Not applicable by default, unless the entity operates under a designated Zona Franca concession.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election exists under Colombian law. The SAS is irreversibly treated as a taxable entity at the corporate level. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available in domestic law but must be assessed under Colombian transfer pricing and anti-hybrid rules consistent with the OECD BEPS recommendations for cross-border operations.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (IVA) — Régimen Común, Colombia
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold — a Colombian SAS engaged in taxable activities or import operations must register in the RUT as an IVA responsible person from incorporation, with immediate effect for customs and VAT purposes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: DIAN requires mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica). The SAS must use DIAN-authorized software providers or the DIAN free e-invoicing application to transmit XML invoices to DIAN for pre-validation and real-time fiscal clearance. Each electronic invoice must include the CUD (Código Único de Documento), a mandatory QR code, DIAN registration status, and be filed in the monthly electronic invoicing mass-reporting module within 5 business days of month-end.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of frozen beef and seafood are subject to the 0% VAT rate only when legal title and risk have passed to the foreign buyer and the goods physically leave Colombian customs territory under the duly submitted Declaración de Exportación (DEX). The exporter is entitled to recover VAT paid on directly attributable inputs through export VAT refund procedures (devolución de IVA). Services are zero-rated only if rendered to foreign recipients and directly used abroad, but are not relevant to the physical goods export model.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX) with DIAN electronic validation
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill duly issued with final foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate (comprobante de ingreso de divisas) issued by a Colombian authorized foreign exchange intermediary
Commercial invoice and packing list, plus Certificado de Origen when applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN and customs authorities may audit the physical exit of goods, the timely filing of the DEX, and the actual repatriation of foreign currency. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days triggers a fiscal clawback of VAT credits, a penalty of 5% of the uncollected/non-repatriated amount, plus default interest and a documentation or transport-related penalty of 0.5% of the export value. Fraudulent or materially false zero-rating claims constitute tax evasion and can be penalized with fines up to 150% of the unpaid tax, disqualification from VAT refund regimes, and criminal liability for senior management under Colombian anti-contraband and money laundering statutes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (the Central Bank), exercising foreign-exchange regulatory powers jointly with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for bank, AML/SARLAFT and Onboarding enforcement, and the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) for customs, Import Declarations and registration of merchants. The core control instruments are Decree 1068 of 2015, Banco de la República Resolution 8 of 2000, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, under which all cross-border trade and investment flows must be canalizadas (routed) through the Mercado Cambiario via authorized Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario (IMCs, i.e., licensed commercial banks).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) operates under a managed float with the TRM (Tasa Representativa del Mercado) published daily. Current-account transactions (import of goods, services, freight, insurance) are freely convertible through IMCs once the corresponding Declaración de Cambio (Form 1 for imports) is filed; capital-account transactions (equity injections, foreign debt, portfolio investment, profit repatriation) are open but require mandatory channeling and, for amounts above USD 500,000, formal registration in the Banco de la República Registro de Inversiones Internacionales. Profit remittances from the S.A.S. to non-resident shareholders are legally permitted after payment of the 35% corporate income tax and the applicable dividend withholding (7.5% on the portion previously subject to corporate tax, plus 35% on any non-taxed portion), provided the remittance is routed through an IMC and supported by the tax Paz y Salvo and audited financial statements. There are no surrender or prior-approval hurdles for genuine trade flows, but import payments exceeding USD 5,000 (FOB) must be made via the foreign-exchange market and cannot be settled offshore.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia imposes no mandatory conversion of export proceeds into COP; exporters may retain foreign currency in local foreign-currency accounts or abroad. However, statutory channeling is compulsory: export proceeds (bienes) must be received and routed through an IMC within six (6) months of the date of receipt of the proceeds and in no case later than twelve (12) months from the date of the export customs declaration (exit). Export credits equal to or exceeding USD 10,000 must be reported on Form 2 (Declaración de Cambio por Exportaciones) by the exporter or the IMC. For this cold-chain importer, any incidental re-export of frozen rejects or inventory must comply with the same deadlines; non-channeling is a financial-exchange infraction subject to fines and exclusion from IMC facilities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) in COP plus USD-denominated foreign-trade account for SWIFT/LC settlement; Capital Escrow Account option for the S.A.S. paid-in capital under its fiducia desk.
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with integrated foreign-trade desk; Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Depósito para Capital) applicable to the initial equity injection.
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) and Revolving Import Letter of Credit structure (Cupo de Cartas de Crédito); no separate escrow account required for the S.A.S.
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with dedicated FX derivatives and forward desk for import-hedging; Capital Escrow Account available via trust or current account designation.
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) and USD compensation account for direct disbursement against DIAN Import Declarations; no statutory escrow mandate.
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with structured trade-finance and confirmed-LC execution; Capital Escrow Account feasible through its commercial trust affiliate.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary clearing rail; Medium only as a supplementary low-value collection or outgoing payment channel. Under Colombian law (Decree 2555/2010 and the SEDPE regime), only licensed banks and duly authorized Sociedades Especializadas en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos (e.g., Nequi, Daviplata) may take deposits or execute domestic payment clearing. Foreign digital EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, Currencycloud, etc.) do not hold a Colombian banking or SEDPE licence, cannot issue Form 1/Form 3 exchange declarations, and cannot execute the mandatory channeling of import payments or export proceeds. Any use of an offshore EMI for trade settlement would breach the canalización obligation and expose the S.A.S. to DIAN and Banco de la República penalties; at most, EMIs may serve as fallback collection rails for non-trade receivables that are subsequently normalized through an IMC.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandated for onboarding a newly incorporated S.A.S.: at least one legal representative or an individually appointed attorney-in-fact (poder especial) must attend an in-person KYC interview at the bank's branch or international desk, presenting the original public deed or private document of incorporation, a Cámara de Comercio certificate of existence and legal representation (issued within 30 days) and valid passports or national ID cards. Powers of attorney executed abroad require notarization, apostille and, in many banks, countersignature by the Colombian consulate; signatory matrices (registro de firmas) are captured in person. Fully remote onboarding is an exceptional concession permitted only for existing clients with certified digital biometric KYC under SFC Circular 029 of 2014; for non-resident directors, most Tier-1 banks will instead request a video-interview plus a physical appearance at a Colombian branch or at a correspondent foreign branch (e.g., Bancolombia Miami or Panama desks).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity: the S.A.S. shareholder chain conceals final natural persons, uses nominee shareholders, or presents mismatched UBO declarations (SFC Circular 048 of 2019 on the Beneficiario Final rule).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized share-registry and corporate resolutions; sworn Declaración de Beneficiario Final with passport/cédula copies; ownership-chain chart up to ultimate natural persons; apostilled powers of attorney; sworn statement of the source of funds and of the economic rationale for the import business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk counterparty or jurisdiction exposure: suppliers, freight forwarders, or transshipment ports in sanctioned, low-tier or opaque jurisdictions (e.g., certain Eastern European or Asian cold-chain hubs) triggering OFAC/UN/SARLAFT red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete commercial contracts and proforma invoices (Incoterms 2020); ICA import health certificate for frozen beef and INVIMA prior-import notification for seafood; bills of lading with vessel/voyage data; freight-forwarder AML questionnaire; cargo insurance certificates; and a supplier due-diligence file proving no sanctioned beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Volume-to-capital mismatch: projected or first-year transactional flows disproportionate to the S.A.S. registered capital (which may be COP 1 under Law 1258 of 2008), creating a money-laundering indicator under SARLAFT transaction matrices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or accountant-certified opening balance sheet and projected cash-flow statement for 12 months; letter of credit facility request; signed supply or framework purchase agreement with the overseas beef/seafood seller; documented equity-injection wire with purpose code; evidence of the commercial warehouse or cold-storage agreement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanitary-documentation red flags: inconsistent HS codes, expired certificates, mismatched product descriptions, or missing cold-chain records in the presented import file (HS 0201/0202 beef; HS 0303/0304 frozen fish).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete documentary package comprising the INVIMA automatic import notification (Registro de Importación), ICA sanitary certificate for bovine products, exporting-country veterinary certificate, laboratory analysis results, container temperature-recorder logs, origin certificate, and the DIAN Import Declaration draft.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders initiate a SWIFT MT103/MT202 wire from their own bank account (in the shareholder's name) to the S.A.S. operational account (Cuenta Corriente) maintained at the chosen Colombian IMC bank. The remittance must be clearly tagged as 'Aporte de Capital – Inversión Internacional' and the bank will file Form 3 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional) using purpose code 2252 (capital contribution for incorporation) or 2253 (subscription and payment of shares in an existing company). Equity injections equal to or above USD 500,000 (or COP equivalent) must be additionally registered in the Banco de la República Registro de Inversiones Internacionales (RII) through the IMC within 12 months of the flow; registration is a precondition for later dividend remittances. The supporting verification file includes the apostilled corporate resolutions, the shareholder registry updated at the Cámara de Comercio, the remitting bank statement proving the upstream account belongs to the foreign investor, and the share-certificate issuance record.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail 1 - SWIFT MT103 against invoice: the S.A.S. instructs the IMC to debit its account, purchase USD/COP at the TRM and wire the supplier; the bank files Form 1 (Declaración de Cambio por Importaciones) under concept code 1110 (importación de bienes), requiring the accepted DIAN Import Declaration (Declaración de Importación) and the supplier invoice; payment terms may not exceed 6 months from the date of the import declaration (extendable to 12 months only with IMC authorization for deferred financing). Prepayments are capped at 12 months before shipment, and any prepayment exceeding the term must be endorsed by the IMC. Primary rail 2 - Revolving Commercial Letter of Credit: the Colombian bank issues an irrevocable, possibly confirmed, letter of credit under UCP 600 in favor of the foreign frozen-beef/seafood seller; upon negotiation of compliant documents (beneficiary draft, commercial invoice, full packing list, bills of lading, insurance certificate, ICA/INVIMA sanitary releases), the bank pays the presenting bank and files Form 1 with the LC transaction code. All outflows are matched against the RUT importers' status, the INVIMA/ICA import certifications, and the DIAN foreign-trade declarations to avoid divergence alerts under SARLAFT.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP OTC Deliverable Forwards (Forwards a la medida) executed through the IMC bank on the Banco de la República-regulated derivative market, strictly back-to-back with the underlying import payables/LC maturities.
USD/COP Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) cash-settled against the TRM, permissible for hedging MT103 and LC payment exposure without requiring physical delivery of COP.

Cross-Currency Swaps (Swaps de Monedas) between COP and USD/EUR, permitted for hedging the FX legs of revolving import facilities and equity-remittance floats, registered with the IMC and the Banco de la República derivatives registry.
USD/COP TRM Futures (Futuros TRM) traded on the Bolsa de Valores de Colombia, allowed as standard exchange-traded hedges against TC appreciation on large scheduled LC drawings.
USD/COP Options (Opciones TRM) structured OTC by Tier-1 IMCs, usable to cap the maximum USD/COP cost of future import disbursements with full SARLAFT underlying-trade documentation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación del Registro Mercantil y actualización del Beneficiario Final (Commercial Registry Renewal and Ultimate Beneficial Owner Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio local (Chamber of Commerce) and Registro Mercantil
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fixed annual window from 1 January through 31 March of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal generates incremental surcharges of 1% per month on the registry fee, loss of certificate eligibility, potential cancellation of the entity's commercial registration, and administrative strike-off after continued non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta de Personas Jurídicas (Annual Corporate Income Tax and Complementary Return, Form 110)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between 10 April and 10 May of each taxable year, assigned on the final digit of the company's NIT (tax registration number)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Untimely filing subjects the company to a late-filing penalty of 5% of the tax shown per month or fraction thereof, up to 100%, plus monthly penalty interest (1.5%) on unpaid tax; repeated non-filing can lead to asset seizure and administrative dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena (Annual Tax Information Return – Impuesto de renta complementary supports, including transfer pricing form if thresholds are met)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 and 30 June per DIAN calendar, depending on taxpayer type and NIT digit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or late filing of exogenous information triggers fines of up to 1% of turnover or COP 20,400 multiplied by the invoiced amount, plus potential administrative closure and limitation of the deduction of costs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Actualización del Registro Único Tributario (RUT) and verification of import quota/license (ISIC 4632 frozen meat and seafood products)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN and Ministry of Commerce (for trade facilitation and sanitary authorization renewals)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On any change in address, legal representative, or activity; annual confirmation during commercial registry renewal for import permit status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or outdated RUT data may result in suspension of import registration, blocking of electronic payment certificates, and penalties per customs infraction rules; failure to maintain valid sanitary/import authorization may lead to cancellation of import permits and prohibition on cold-chain clearance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Article 203 of the Colombian Commercial Code, a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada must appoint a Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) if it meets any of the following at the relevant fiscal year-end: (i) total gross assets exceed 5,000 current monthly minimum legal wages (smmlv); (ii) gross revenues exceed 3,000 smmlv; (iii) workforce exceeds 200 employees; or (iv) the company is publicly held, is a financial or public-interest entity, or is otherwise required by specific regulations.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Law 1314 of 2009 mandates accrual accounting; the S.A.S. must prepare statutory financial statements under the Colombian group-model standards: Full IFRS if classified in Group 1; IFRS for SMEs (Sección 1 of NIIF para Pymes) if in Group 2, which is the default for most import trading S.A.S. entities; certain small entities may use simplified local GAAP (Group 3).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must complete and register an annual declaration of ultimate beneficial owners during the January-to-March commercial registry renewal window. Any shareholding transfer or change in direct or indirect ownership exceeding a relevant threshold occurring in the preceding calendar year must be reported concurrently in the Registro de Beneficiario Final (RUBF). The declaration is submitted electronically with notary-authorized documentation where applicable.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday is available to a Colombian S.A.S. engaged in wholesale import and distribution of frozen meat and seafood. A reduced 20% corporate income tax rate is available only to entities operating under Free Trade Zone authorization, which this importer has not been granted. Certain marginal deductions under Law 2277 of 2022 exist for investments in fixed productive assets, but no preferential effective rate attaches to the ordinary trading activity described in ISIC 4632.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios para Personas Jurídicas y Asimiladas; filed electronically through the DIAN habilitated portal (Sede Electrónica / PUCE).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Fiscal year ends 31 December. The filing deadline is set annually by DIAN Resolution according to the last two digits of the NIT, generally falling between August 10 and September 15 of the following taxable year. Extension is not automatic; requests for extension under Article 12 of the Tax Statute Procedures may be submitted only in limited circumstances.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification number, corporate name, and fiscal address of the S.A.S.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Colombian NIT of the S.A.S.; the non-resident shareholders are not entered on the entity return except as beneficial owners in mandatory informative annexes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total ordinary income accruable for Colombian tax purposes, including import sale revenue, realized foreign exchange gains, and any incidental income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all worldwide income of the Colombian S.A.S.; no consolidation with non-resident shareholder income is permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of imported frozen beef and seafood, customs duties, freight, cold-chain handling, storage, financing, and deductible overheads.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs paid abroad must be supported by invoices and customs declarations; payments to related foreign suppliers are subject to transfer pricing limitations in the explanations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after applying allowed deductions, tax loss carryforwards, and prior year compensation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For treaty purposes, ensure that any compensation to foreign shareholders is not added back unless challenged on economic substance grounds.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income tax liability at 35% on net liquid income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident shareholder does not pay corporate income tax on this line, but only the distributed dividend withholding tax in Colombia.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for advance income tax (renta presuntiva adjustments), withholding taxes borne by the entity, and foreign tax credits if applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withholdings imposed on Colombian import payments to the S.A.S. are creditable; withholding imposed on dividend distributions is not creditable on the corporate return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net final tax due after prepayments, withholding credits, and discounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay in Colombian pesos through DIAN recaudo mechanisms; if a refund is claimed, additional documentation of effective withholding and tax residency of counterparties may be required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form 210 triggers a penalty of 5% of the balance tax payable per month or fraction of a month, capped at 100%, subject to a minimum penalty of 10 UVT. If no tax is payable, the penalty is 2.5% of gross income, not exceeding 1,000 UVT. Any unpaid balance also accrues moratory interest at the effective bank lending rate plus two points. Criminal prosecution for intentional omission is available to DIAN under Articles 426 of the Criminal Code, with imprisonment and disqualification.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends paid by the Colombian S.A.S. to a non-resident shareholder, computed on the full dividend distribution. If the taxpayer distributes profits that were not previously taxed at the corporate level, the additional taxable amount is subject to CIT at 35% in the S.A.S. before the dividend WHT is computed.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced dividend rate under a Double Tax Agreement, the non-resident shareholder must (i) submit a current Certificate of Tax Residence issued by the competent authority of the treaty jurisdiction, (ii) provide the Colombian S.A.S. with custody of the certificate before payment, (iii) present the DTA article analysis in Form 227 (Información Exógena) when applicable, and (iv) ensure the shareholder is the beneficial owner and not a conduit that strips treaty benefits. DIAN may require a sworn statement of economic substance and ownership chain. The payer must file the DTA form electronically and retain the supporting documentation for 5 years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: Colombian statutory final withholding is 30% on gross royalty and license payments to non-residents; treaty rates commonly reduce this to 10%–15% (e.g., France, Spain, Canada). Interest: statutory final withholding is 15% on interest paid to foreign financial institutions and 25% on interest paid to non-bank lenders; applicable DTA treaty rates typically range from 10% to 15%, subject to the lender being the beneficial owner and respecting arm's-length pricing and thin cap limits.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File for fiscal year 2024 apply if the taxpayer's gross income equals or exceeds 250,000 UVT (COP 11,766,250,000) or gross assets equal or exceed 150,000 UVT (COP 7,059,750,000). Transactions with foreign related parties also require the annual transfer pricing information return (Información Exógena TP) and a contemporaneous descriptive report. The importer of frozen beef and seafood must therefore test each related-party cross-border purchase under the arm's-length standard.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia has not enacted a separate Economic Substance Regulations regime in the manner of offshore financial centres. However, the Colombian Tax Statute (Articles 260-1 et seq.), the anti-abuse rule in Article 87-8, and the S.A.S. veil-piercing provisions of Law 1258 of 2008 require genuine commercial substance. A frozen/seafood importer with no physical warehouse, no fixed employees, passive management, or circular banking structures is exposed to GAAR recharacterization, denial of deductions, and personal liability of directors for the misuse of the corporate form.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating gross income, inflating import costs through fictitious cold-chain suppliers, using false customs values for frozen beef, or deliberately misreporting inventory to reduce taxable revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Evasion of income tax above 200 minimum monthly legal wages triggers criminal tax fraud with imprisonment from 48 to 120 months, a fine up to the equivalent of the evaded tax, and disqualification from contracting with the State. Civilly, DIAN may reassess the tax, impose a penalty of 200% of the omitted tax, and collect moratory interest from the period of omission.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who formulate or execute fraudulent tax returns bear joint and several civil liability for the omitted tax, penalties, and interest. Courts may order asset freezing, travel bans, and forfeiture of personal estate where the S.A.S. was used as a mere instrument to conceal taxable income.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Colombian S.A.S. as a shell entity with no independent management, no employees, no operational premises, or with all substantive decision-making made abroad in order to obtain invoicing and tax residence advantages.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 1258 of 2008, a court or DIAN applied under the anti-abuse rule may pierce the corporate veil and disregard the separate legal personality. The tax consequences include disallowance of all deductions, attribution of the importer's operations to the foreign parent, and application of a 35% corporate income tax plus a 10% dividend withholding tax deemed to have been paid abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director or shareholder who caused the S.A.S. to be used for tax avoidance is personally liable up to the portion not covered by the entity's assets. Personal remedies include a travel ban, civil restitution of the avoided tax, and imprisonment of up to 100 months where the structure is used to evade customs duties or income tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare Local and Master Files, failure to file the annual TP information return, or economic pricing manipulation in the purchase of frozen livestock and seafood from related foreign suppliers that departs from CUP or TNMM.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN imposes a penalty equal to 2% of the total value of the related-party transactions for formal documentation omissions, plus a penalty of up to 200% of the tax arising from the price adjustment in the event of non-documentation. Late filing of the TP return results in fines of 20 UVT per day of delay up to 5,000 UVT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors approving the transaction documents are jointly liable for the inflation of costs to the extent they had knowledge of the artificial pricing. Upon judicial reassessment, directors may be barred from leaving the country during the tax examination and exposed to monetary restitution for the additional tax and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the import of frozen beef or seafood as a vehicle for trade-based money laundering, including over-invoicing from shell exporters, receiving suspicious funds through Revolving LC or Swift TT without beneficial owner disclosure, or issuing forged customs invoices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 1762 of 2015 (Anti-Smuggling and Customs Fraud Statute), smuggling or customs misdeclaration carries fines of up to 500% of the customs value, seizure of the goods, and imprisonment from 6 to 20 years for the legal representatives. The Superintendent of Companies and DIAN may impose sanctions under the AML framework applicable to the real-sector importer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly endorse money-laundering transactions have personal criminal liability, civil confiscation of assets, prohibition from exercising commercial activities in Colombia for up to 10 years, and, where the funds are frozen abroad, a personal travel is forbidden and extradition is not excluded for high-value laundering cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Omission of Informative Returns and Tax Records
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the complementary informative tax returns (e.g., Exogenous Information, CREE affiliates, TP information return), failure to maintain contemporaneous import documentation, or non-submission of the annual beneficial owner registry in the S.A.S. minutes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN imposes fines from 10,000 to 15,000 UVT for failure to file informative returns, and the corporate registry may be suspended. The tax obligations are not extinguished by the fine: the entire return is deemed unreliable and may be subject to presumption in favor of DIAN regarding income and asset valuations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director who fails to keep accounting and supporting records of the cold-chain import transactions is liable for the resulting inability to verify costs; courts can order the reimbursement of tax benefits to the treasury from the director's personal assets and impose a commensurate prison term for fraud.
